acceptedAnswer.text: While shower remodeling can be done year-round in Las Vegas, some homeowners prefer to schedule projects during specific times. The cooler months, typically fall and winter, can be ideal as they avoid the intense summer heat, which can be more comfortable for workers and might align with your personal travel schedules. However, due to the controlled indoor environment, shower remodels are not significantly impacted by external weather, allowing for flexibility. We accommodate projects based on your availability and our schedule.
